text: Compare buffer occupancy with downstream packed-count changes and upstream state at corresponding timestamps. Accumulation with reduced observed downstream throughput indicates a flow imbalance. It does not establish whether the cause is a jam, supply problem or planned slowdown. Inspect downstream status using the site's approved procedure. The PLC owns sequencing and interlocks.
